book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: Passepartout was sitting in the kitchen, at ease.
And suddenly, at 7:50, Fogg came in.
Four hours before his time.

sentences.ar: وقال: باسبارتو، بعد عشر دقايق بنطلع.
sentences.en: And said: Passepartout, in ten minutes we leave.
For Dover, Calais, and then round the world.
Passepartout opened his mouth.
And said: round... the world?
Fogg said: in eighty days.
We have no time to lose.
Passepartout said: and the luggage?
Fogg said: no luggage.
One bag.
Two shirts, three pairs of stockings, each.
And the rest we buy on the way.
And Passepartout went up, the world spinning.

sentences.ar: وقال لحاله: وأنا اللي بدي حياة هادية!
sentences.en: And said to himself: and I who wanted a quiet life!
At eight, they were at the door.

sentences.ar: فوغ حط بالكيس رزمة مصاري: عشرين ألف جنيه ورق.
sentences.en: Fogg put in the bag a bundle of money: twenty thousand pounds in notes.

sentences.ar: وأعطى الكيس لباسبارتو، وقال: دير بالك عليه.
sentences.en: And gave the bag to Passepartout, and said: take care of it.

sentences.ar: وبالطريق للمحطة، وقفت لهم مرا فقيرة، وبإيدها ولد.
sentences.en: And on the way to the station, a poor woman stopped them, a child in her hand.

sentences.ar: فوغ أعطاها المصاري اللي ربحها بالورق، كلها.
sentences.en: Fogg gave her the money he had won at cards, all of it.
And said: take it, madam.
I am glad to have met you.
And Passepartout felt his eyes grow moist.
And said: this man has a heart.
At the station, the five friends were waiting.
Fogg said: my passport.

sentences.ar: رح أختمه بكل بلد، عشان تتأكدوا.
sentences.en: I will have it stamped in every country, so you can be sure.

sentences.ar: قال مدير البنك: ما في داعي.
sentences.en: The bank director said: no need.
You are a gentleman.
Fogg said: better so.
And boarded the train.
At 8:45, the train whistled, and moved.
And Passepartout suddenly cried: good God!
Fogg said: what?

sentences.ar: قال باسبارتو: نسيت الغاز بأوضتي مشعول!
sentences.en: Passepartout said: I left the gas in my room burning!
Fogg said calmly: it stays burning.
At your expense.
